_readme: Curated overrides for the role tags inferred by scripts/build-card-db.mjs.
Effect-text heuristics are imperfect; corrections belong here, not in the generator.
Names are normalised the same way as src/lib/normalize.ts (lowercase, no
apostrophes or accents), so the key for Boss's Orders is "bosss orders".
Keyed on name rather than an id so curation survives a card-data refresh.
Curation wins over inference. Keys that match no card are ignored.
